map.以当地无霜期初日与终日构成安全窗口：先加安全余量得最晚播种日，再加作物生育期得预: Take the first and last day of the local frost-free period as the safe window: add a safety margin to get the latest sowing date, then add the crop growth period to get the expected harvest date. The margin in days = last frost-free day - expected harvest date; >=0 means the harvest comes before the frost and the window is sufficient, while a negative value signals frost risk and suggests sowing earlier or switching to an early variety. The total frost-free days are the difference between the two dates.
map.喜温作物以终霜后地温稳定通过 10~12℃ 为适播指标。: Warm-loving crops use a soil temperature that stays above 10-12 degC after the last frost as the sowing indicator.
map.地温比气温更准吗？: Is soil temperature more reliable than air temperature?
map.填写「无霜期初日」。: Enter the "first day of the frost-free period".
map.填写「无霜期终日」。: Enter the "last day of the frost-free period".
map.安全播期 = 终霜日 + 苗期耐霜裕度，或 = 初霜日 − 生育期 − 缓冲。: Safe sowing date = last frost date + seedling frost tolerance margin, or = first frost date - growth period - buffer.
map.对播种而言地温更准，因为种子萌发取决于种床温度而非气温。5~10 cm 地温是农: For sowing, soil temperature is more reliable because germination depends on the seedbed temperature rather than the air temperature. Soil temperature at 5-10 cm is the quantified version of the farming saying that "when the ground warms, the season opens".
map.播种日期计算器（基于无霜期） 使用指南: How to use the sowing date calculator (based on the frost-free period)
map.无霜期播种窗口推算器，依据当地无霜期与作物生育期倒推安全播种与收获日期，降低霜冻: A frost-free sowing window calculator that works back from the local frost-free period and the crop growth period to derive safe sowing and harvest dates, reducing frost risk.
map.春播看终霜（防苗期冻害），秋熟看初霜（防贪青受冻）。两者共同框定安全生长期的上下: Spring sowing watches the last frost (to protect seedlings from frost damage) and autumn ripening watches the first frost (to prevent frost damage to late grain). Together they bound the safe growing period above and below.
map.最晚播种日 = 无霜期初日 + 安全余量；预计收获日 = 最晚播种日 + 生育期: Latest sowing date = first day of the frost-free period + safety margin; expected harvest date = latest sowing date + growth period; margin in days = last day of the frost-free period - expected harvest date
map.用于春玉米、棉花、大豆等作物的适播窗口确定。: Used to determine the suitable sowing window for spring maize, cotton, soybean and other crops.
map.种植密度计算器（株距×行距）: Planting density calculator (plant spacing x row spacing)
map.终霜日和初霜日哪个更关键？: Which matters more, the last frost date or the first frost date?
map.：当地终霜 4 月 10 日，大豆出苗需地温稳定 ≥10℃ 且苗期耐轻霜。以终霜: : the local last frost is 10 April, and soybean emergence needs soil temperature steadily >=10 degC with seedlings tolerant of light frost. Take 5 days after the last frost (15 April) as the lower bound, check the measured soil temperature at 5 cm, and sow once it has stayed above 10 degC, no later than 10 May so the crop ripens before the autumn frost.
